Fusion
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fusion"** means the process or result of joining two or more things together to form a single entity. (संलयन)

 
 
• **Example: **The fusion of different musical styles creates a unique sound.
 
 
 
• **"Blend"** refers to mixing or combining things together into a single entity. (मिश्रण)
 
 
• **Example: **She made a smoothie by blending various fruits.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Grind** (पीसना): To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

 
 
• **Example:** He used a mortar and pestle to grind the spices.
 
 
 
• **Glide** (फिसलना): To move smoothly and continuously along a surface.
 
 
• **Example:** The skaters glide gracefully across the ice.
 
 
 
• **Ingredient** (सामग्री): Any of the foods or substances that are combined to make a particular dish.
 
 
• **Example:** The recipe requires several ingredients, including flour and sugar.
